Class MapCanvas

java.lang.Object
gui.MapCanvas
public class MapCanvas extends Object
Manages the canvas for rendering the SUMO network map, vehicles, traffic lights, and routes. Handles coordinate transformations, user interactions (zoom, pan), filtering, and various rendering modes. Integrates with View and Transform classes for view management.
